definitions_and_hypotheses_checked: M72ReconstructionConclusion carries a finite event ledger, bijective summand reindexing, exact piece equalities, a smooth finite connected-sum assembly, target nonemptiness, target connectedness, and successor transport; the draft uses the same-flow fields rather than an arbitrary factor family.

M73 assumes the original smooth measurable three-manifold is simply connected and uses the initial identification to transport this property to the exact time-zero slice. Each factor receives connectedness from its event topology and simple connectedness from the M54 assembly factor certificate.

The sphere-bundle obstruction assumes compact total carrier and formal bundle local trivializations; it does not assume a pre-existing universal cover of the carrier. The lift is through the real-to-circle exponential covering.

Positive-spaceform classification assumes a positive curvature constant, compactness, and factor simple connectedness. The proof rescales to sectional curvature one, constructs a spherical covering, and uses target simple connectedness to make it bijective.

A connected-sum step retains radius-two ball charts, removed closed radius-one balls, arbitrary sphere gluing diffeomorphism, collar inverse and smoothness, and a disjoint cover by two source regions and the central sphere. The binary sphere identity is proved for these supplied data, including both orientation classes.

The Schoenflies input is quantified over every embedded smooth collar and every width 0<delta<1. The full oriented half-collar is in the chart-image identity; the radial function is initially only strictly increasing. Its smoothness and nonzero derivative near the original surgery sphere are proved from the inverse chart and immersion.

The sphere-union invariant is a finite clopen region family with smooth region equivalences and sphere maps. Its definition allows the empty family, while M74 separately assumes target nonemptiness and connectedness.

M75EndpointInput stores the global certificate and a reduction of that certificate's own time-zero carrier; m75EndpointInputFromExtinction sets the global field definitionally equal to the supplied flow.

Metric rescaling with unchanged Levi-Civita connection, curvature normalization, standard spherical covering, covering bijectivity under simple connectedness, and gluing local smooth inverses.

Explicit shifted collar v(t)=(1+2t)/(2+t), sign and bounded-side identification, exact smaller-ball image, recovery of radial regularity, orthogonal-to-boundary isotopy with linear germ, positive convex radial splice, reciprocal collar coordinates, compression H, inversion J and two stereographic charts with transition J.
